body:
### Description

The following code gives me NaNs about half the time, and a correct factorization the other half:
```python
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
mat = jax.random.normal(jax.random.PRNGKey(0), (4096, 4096))    
mat = mat @ mat.T    
mat /= jnp.max(jnp.abs(mat))    
cho, upper = jax.scipy.linalg.cho_factor(mat)    
print(cho)
```

This only occurs on GPU, not on CPU.

### What jax/jaxlib version are you using?
0.4.8/0.4.7

### Which accelerator(s) are you using?

GPU
